texts.preamble: Prataparam vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:21291) on 2 May, 2025 Author: Nupur Bhati Bench: Nupur Bhati [2025:Rj-Jd:21291] High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At Jodhpur S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 5132/2025 Prataparam S/o Hakmaram, Aged About 40 Years, Resdient Of Brahmanon Ka Bas Balera Police Station Sarwana District Jalore (Presently Lodged In Jodhpur Jail) ----Petitioner Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Public Prosecutor ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Siddharth Mewara For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, Pp Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Nupur Bhati Order 02/05/2025 1. The present bail application has been filed under Section 483 B.N.S.S. on behalf of the petitioner, who is in custody in connection with F.I.R. No.64/2025 dated 07.02.2025, registered at Police Station Sanchore, District Jalore, for the offences under Sections 274, 275, 318(2), 336(2), 342(2), 349(A), 350(1) and 61(2)(A) of Bns, Section 3 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Sections 102 and 103 of the Trade Marks Act. 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely roped in this case.
texts.facts: The present bail application has been filed under Section 483 B.N.S.S. on behalf of the petitioner, who is in custody in connection with F.I.R. No.64/2025 dated 07.02.2025, registered at Police Station Sanchore, District Jalore, for the offences under Sections 274, 275, 318(2), 336(2), 342(2), 349(A), 350(1) and 61(2)(A) of Bns, Section 3 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Sections 102 and 103 of the Trade Marks Act.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely roped in this case. He submits that the offences alleged against the petitioner are exclusively triable by the Court of Magistrate. He submits that the charge-sheet has been filed. He further submits that the co-accused namely Champat Kumar, Bharmal, Manoj Kumar and Achlaram have been enlarged on bail by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 15.04.2025 in a bunch of files led by SBCRLMB No.3572/2025.
